question: How many Indian dances have been recognised by the Sangeet Natak Akademi as classical dance forms as of May 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi:-**

 
 
• **It is the national academy of music, dance, and drama in India. **
 
• It was established in 1953 by the Government of India to promote and preserve the performing arts of India.
 
• The Akademi is headquartered in New Delhi, India, and has branches in all major cities of India.
 
• As of May 2022, the Sangeet Natak Akademi has recognized eight Indian dances as classical dance forms:
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam**
 
• **Kathak**
 
• **Kuchipudi**
 
• **Odissi**
 
• **Kathakali**
 
• **Sattriya**
 
• **Manipuri**
 
• **Mohiniyattam**
